title: Resource response observation
description: Close context written by the BEAR.EventSourcing observation bridge. The body is never inlined: body_ref points at an externalized rendered body and is not extracted into Event::result. A code of 400 or greater marks a failed operation, which is never extracted as an event. code is omitted when a resource invocation threw and the exception's own code is not itself a valid HTTP status (400-599): the real status is decided later by the application's error handler, which the observation bridge runs ahead of, so it is never guessed here; exception.class and exception.message are recorded instead. A missing code paired with a present exception is read as a confirmed failure and is never extracted as an event, exactly like code >= 400.

body_ref.description: Storage pointer to the externalized rendered body; stays in the log for inspection only.

durationMs.description: Wall time of the inner invocation in milliseconds, including child operations. Observation data: never part of event identity.
